correctness.rationale: Exponential representation is exact. The reciprocal indicator is a strict three-gap local minimum, the three exceedance probabilities integrate to e^{-u1},e^{-2u2},e^{-3u3}/3. Every pair of overlapping distinct rare windows is O(n^{-4/3}) or smaller; factorial-moment cluster counting gives independent Poisson rates. Endpoint exceptions vanish and S/n normalization changes centered extremes by o_P(1). The finite verifier checked 142,730 structural assertions and 10 numerical comparisons; finite checks do not prove the infinite limit.

value.rationale: The longest ordinary gap, longest outgoing-nearest-neighbor link, and longest reciprocal-neighbor edge are natural but distinct spatial-network robustness summaries. The newly derived third scale log n/(3n), and joint independence at three nonidentical Gumbel centers, provide calibrated extreme thresholds not supplied by count statistics or individual outgoing-link results. It is not a renaming of the classical marginal law.
